title: In JetBrains Datalore before 2026.4 hidden notebook code was exposed to unauthenticated users via the public…
description: A vulnerability in JetBrains Datalore versions before 2026.4 allowed unauthenticated users to access hidden notebook code via the public interactive report content endpoint. This exposure could lead to unauthorized disclosure of potentially sensitive code. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 5.3, indicating a medium severity impact primarily affecting confidentiality. No official patch or remediation details are provided in the available data.
